summary.tldr: Requires the federal women and gender equality minister to lead ongoing national action on intimate partner violence and report to Parliament every two years.
what_it_does: Requires the Minister for Women and Gender Equality to continue leading national action to prevent and address intimate partner violence.

Requires annual talks with other federal ministers and provincial ministers responsible for the status of women, and regular talks with Indigenous partners, victims and survivors, and other stakeholders.
Requires those talks to cover current programs, partnerships, costs, and any constitutional, legal or jurisdictional issues.
Requires the talks to begin within one year after royal assent.
Requires the minister to table a progress report in both Houses of Parliament within two years after royal assent, then every two years, and to post it online within 30 days after tabling.
summary.background: The bill defines intimate partner to include a current or former spouse, common-law partner, or dating partner. It names the Minister for Women and Gender Equality as the lead minister.
